analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold from 32.0 to 42.3. MACD histogram improves from -1972.2513 to 87.7348, signaling bottoming. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price of 206,000 KRW compared to the 5-day low of 187,000 KRW. Trading volume is subdued at 0.69x the 5-day average, requiring confirmation of direction.
